# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Essays and field notes on data architecture for practitioners: data modeling,
dimensional modeling, data contracts, the semantic layer, the lakehouse, and the
craft of building systems that make information trustworthy. Written in an
answer-first style; each essay states its core claim up front.
